method: Excel 16 COM CalculateFullRebuild on temporary workbook copies; original workbook Value2, IEEE-754 binary64 bits, formula, display, and number format are retained. Engine receives only source geometry/configuration and literal catalog snapshot inputs. EXACT compares exact rationals with the captured IEEE-754 rational. DISPLAY_MATCH compares the exact engine rational formatted according to the source number format; it does not imply equal underlying values. No epsilon is used.
